The '''Kuat Service Ribbon''' was a [[Ribbon/Legends|ribbon]] bar awarded to members of the [[Republic First Fleet]] in recognition of active duty in defense of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]].<ref name="TOR" />
